title: Tile map: a legend card at the left, a tile grid of 31 regions with one-character names on a four-step green scale, a focus outline and a pinned dark tooltip
use: A region map for any index with four classes by rank. --param seed seeds the values, --param focus (0-30) picks the focus tile; the tooltip's name, class and numbers come from that tile.

theme.note: light (ivory #FAF9F5) or dark (#141413) ground; tile names and the tooltip keep their fixed inks

focus.note: the focus tile (0 = the top-right unit, counted row by row)

lede.default: 各省份的关注度相对账户占比，高于 1 表示比预期更热。示例数据。

legend_desc.default: 看某地区对板块的关注比按账户占比的预期高（大于 1）还是低（小于 1）。

hint.default: 指针悬停或点按省份查看明细

tip_class.note: the class of the focus tile, from legend_1..4

tip_v2.note: the focus tile's share of the total

relations: Tiles 70 on a 74 pitch (the page's 65 on 69), 8 x 8 cells, a sans 30 / 500 name in fixed dark ink on every tile; four classes by rank (8, 8, 8, 7 tiles); the focus tile has a 2.5 ink outline.
The legend card is 400 x 310, radius 16, white, a bold 17 title, a 15 description and four 14-unit dots; the map panel is #F5F4ED, radius 8.
The tooltip is 4 x 2 cells in the grid's empty top-left corner (no name is covered): #3D3D3A, radius 8, a serif 20 name over a 1 rule, the class and two rows.
decoration: The panel, the card, the focus outline and the tooltip plate and rule are decoration; the tile names are real text.

provenance.corpus: market hotspot index explorer kit (examples/index-explorer-kit): our own original data page in the index-explorer grammar; every number is generated in the page and marked as sample data
provenance.experiment: styles/index-explorer/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The data page's map section re-set: legend card, tile grid, tooltip; the tile grid is a generic 31-unit table, not a map file.
measured: Tile 65 px on a 69 px pitch, radius 0, label sans 23 / 500; legend card white, 1 px #C9C4C4, radius 16; scale #BEE5D8 #89D1B9 #59B295 #388F76; tooltip #3D3D3A radius 8 pad 16 serif 16 name.
Template: the tooltip sits in the empty corner so it never covers a tile name; every focus value 0-30 passes.
